title: P104: prove all 6,279 original MOVEs independent of earlier coframe history
body:
## Summary
Excludes reconstruction of any original #7481 MOVE solely from strictly earlier destination-coframe observations.

## Result
All 6,279 MOVEs innovate for 1,501 arbitrary inputs; 7,780 independent observations across 979 coframes. Remains true after every subset of 72 neutral helper zeros. Also retains 47 owned, 18 live-public and 33 main-only certificates.

## Verification
Independent chronological and rational/modular engines; exact 76,475-event replay, mutation and false-history controls. Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-earlier-destination-cache-bound`.

## Scope and kappa
Original histories, whole outputs and coframes fixed. Imported data, changed producers, nonneutral relations and partial decoders remain open. No new kappa. All five foundational assumptions remain.

## Credit and details
#7481, #7308, #6069 and source authors credited. Prepared for @CubeJerry with OpenAI assistance; original notices retained. See `research/p104-earlier-destination-cache-bound/PR-DESCRIPTION.md` and `VALIDATION.json` for full proof, pins and controls. Canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; no independent human/formal acceptance claimed.
